title: The Merry Men
summary: A collection of five short stories by Robert Louis Stevenson, set in the rugged landscapes and maritime culture of Scotland. The title story follows a narrator's return to his ancestral home on the remote Ross of Grisapol, where he encounters tales of shipwrecks, superstition, and family secrets. Other stories include 'Will o' the Mill,' about a lonely shepherd’s tragic fate; 'Markheim,' a psychological tale of morality and temptation; 'Thrawn Janet,' a dark legend of witchcraft in rural Scotland; and 'Olalla,' set in Spain among an isolated aristocratic family. The collection blends adventure, mystery, and gothic elements with Stevenson’s evocative descriptions of wild coasts and haunting folklore.
